notes.title: Demo Release & Bugfix Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39880103/bc4eaa193c7922b6217dfd94c6fb768a28a1e7d8.png[/img]


Starlight Alliance is currently on sale, a bugfix update went life today, but there's something else, as well:

A free demo is online as of now, and it's quite big, too! It contains about 2-3 hours of gameplay, including several bosses. Why not give it a go?

notes.title: Starlight Alliance now in Beta Testing Phase
notes.content:
Reaching the beta stage is one of those kinds of milestones that feel really big. From this point on, the focus shifts from content creation to improving the overall quality of the game. It also means it's high time to take care of the business aspects.

But the past part is this: [u]It won't be long until the game's release.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39880103/3cbc5a06d105dd4b8d98e7dafc7d03d16fad31b8.png[/img]
